description_sq:
Ne nje prej zonave elitare te kryeqytetit shitet apartament luksoz 2+1+2.
Apartamenti ka vendndodhje favorizuese tek Rruga e Elbasanit prane Fakultetit Ekonomik.
Vendodhja strategjike i mundeson akses te menjehershem me rruget kryesore dhe parkun e liqenit.
Ky apartament vjen totalisht i investuar me detaje luksoze si ne rifinitura e po ashtu ne mobilim dhe eshte i pabanuar me pare. Ofron organizim ideal te gjithe hapesirave te apartamentit, duke bere shfrytezim dhe ndarje te rregullt midis ambientit te dites dhe dhomave te gjumit.
Organizohet me korridor hyres, ambient dite sebashku me kuzhinen dhe dalje ne ballkon. Korridori ben shperndarjen dhe ne 2 dhoma e gjumit. (matrimonialja ka tualet personal) dhe tualet qendror.
Te dy tualetet jane me dritare.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katet e larta te objektit gje qe i siguron privatesi, pamje te lire dhe plote drite.
Ky apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
description_en: In one of the elite areas of the capital, a luxury apartment 2+1+2 is for sale. The apartment has a favorable location on Rruga e Elbasani near the Faculty of Economics. The strategic location allows immediate access to major roads and the lake park. This apartment comes fully invested with luxurious details, both in refinishing and furniture, and it is uninhabited before. It offers ideal organization of all the spaces of the apartment, making proper use and separation between the living room and bedrooms. It is organized with an entrance corridor, living room together with the kitchen and exit to the balcony. The corridor also divides the 2 bedrooms. (the matrimonial house has a private toilet) and a central toilet. Both toilets have windows. The apartment is located on the upper floors of the building, which provides privacy, a clear view and full of light. This apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
